name: Lemon-Parsley Panko Crusted Cod with Creamy Spinach & Mushroom Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
227 g cremini mushrooms
1 (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallot.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Zest and juice lemon into the skillet; add half the shallot (reserving the rest for later) and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add parsley, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until bread crumbs begin to brown, 3-4 minutes. Remove skillet from the heat.

Pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Coat the top side of each fillet with mayo, then press the bread crumb mixture on top to form a crust. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until the fish is cooked through and flaky, about 15 minutes.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, thinly slice mushrooms.

Once the skillet is hot, add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add remaining shallot, mushrooms, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until veggies start to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add cream cheese and cream to the skillet; stir until combined and warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide baked cod and veggie sauté between bowls or plates. Enjoy!
